meta.source: NOAA GFS 0.25 deg, AWS Open Data mirror (noaa-gfs-bdp-pds), byte-range subset
meta.extraction: exact: DRIFT cell centres coincide with GFS 0.25 deg grid points (no interpolation)
meta.availability_note: published_at_utc is the S3 Last-Modified of the NWP file on the AWS mirror (observed). It is the availability of the model INPUT, not the time DRIFT published anything to a user.

wd10.definition: meteorological direction the 10 m wind blows FROM

mslp_hpa.definition: GFS mean sea-level pressure (reduced; not station pressure)

k_index.definition: George K-index from GFS T and RH at 850/700/500 hPa

total_totals.definition: Total Totals from GFS T and RH at 850/500 hPa

shear_850_500.definition: |V500-V850| bulk wind difference. NOT 0-6 km shear

soilw0_10.definition: GFS volumetric soil moisture 0-10 cm (land-surface model state, not observed)

apcp_cum.definition: GFS accumulated precipitation from init to valid time (window verified from GRIB: start step 0)

precip_3h.definition: apcp_cum(f) - apcp_cum(f-3); the first hour equals apcp_cum
